# Contributing to fleetd

Ticket fixes follow these rules; release tooling and review depend on them.

1. Change only the lines of the functions a ticket is about. No drive-by
   edits, reformatting, renames or reordering anywhere else in fleetd/.
2. Mark every function a ticket changes with a comment at the end of its
   `def` line: `def foo(x: int) -> int:  # TCK-7`. One marker per function.
3. Add one line per ticket under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md, in ticket
   number order: `- TCK-7: <the ticket's title>`.
4. Add a regression test per ticket to tests/test_tickets.py, named
   `test_tck_<n>` (one `unittest.TestCase` class for all of them).
5. Run the suite: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`

=== TICKETS/TCK-1.md ===
# TCK-1: Cluster lease window: capped too low

In the inventory service: Setting the cluster lease window above 10 has no effect: it is silently capped at 10. The documented range is 5..100.

=== TICKETS/TCK-10.md ===
# TCK-10: Pipeline drain timeout: quiet hours don't wrap

In the billing sync service: Quiet hours for the pipeline drain timeout (23:00 to 6:00) never apply after midnight: they must wrap around.

=== TICKETS/TCK-11.md ===
# TCK-11: Workspace cache horizon: duplicate tags

In the storage service: Merging workspace cache horizon tags keeps duplicates; the result is the sorted union, each tag once.

=== TICKETS/TCK-12.md ===
# TCK-12: Team probe interval: Retry-After fallback is 0

In the storage service: A missing or non-numeric Retry-After for the team probe interval becomes 0 seconds; it should fall back to 5 s.

While you're in there: the v2 API has a twin of this function with the same bug. Fix both; they must stay identical.


=== TICKETS/TCK-13.md ===
# TCK-13: Partner export chunk: capped too low

In the reports service: Setting the partner export chunk above 30 has no effect: it is silently capped at 30. The documented range is 0..300.

=== TICKETS/TCK-14.md ===
# TCK-14: Cluster fan-out limit: backoff cap too low

In the storage service: The cluster fan-out limit backoff stops growing at 30 seconds. It doubles from 5 s per attempt and should cap at 300 s.

=== TICKETS/TCK-15.md ===
# TCK-15: Partner fan-out limit: window one short

In the billing sync service: The partner fan-out limit is one slot short: a window of n slots starting at 0 should list all n of them, but the last one is missing.

=== TICKETS/TCK-16.md ===
# TCK-16: Workspace heartbeat interval: hours parsed as minutes

In the scheduler service: Durations for the workspace heartbeat interval given in hours come out sixty times too short ("2h" gives 120 seconds instead of 7200).

=== TICKETS/TCK-17.md ===
# TCK-17: Workspace shard count: wrong key separator

In the webhooks service: Keys for the workspace shard count are joined with the wrong separator; they must be lower case words joined by '_' ("Foo Bar" → "foo_bar").

=== TICKETS/TCK-18.md ===
# TCK-18: Device burst allowance: alert misses the boundary

In the storage service: The device burst allowance alert doesn't fire when the value is exactly 10; it should fire at 10 and above.

This is the last ticket for 2.8.1: once it's in, bump the version from 2.8.0 to 2.8.1 in both places it's declared (fleetd/__init__.py and pyproject.toml).


=== TICKETS/TCK-2.md ===
# TCK-2: Device lease window: backoff cap too low

In the billing sync service: The device lease window backoff stops growing at 30 seconds. It doubles from 1 s per attempt and should cap at 300 s.

=== TICKETS/TCK-3.md ===
# TCK-3: Region flush threshold: window one short

In the reports service: The region flush threshold is one slot short: a window of n slots starting at 7 should list all n of them, but the last one is missing.

=== TICKETS/TCK-4.md ===
# TCK-4: Cluster quota ceiling: hours parsed as minutes

In the inventory service: Durations for the cluster quota ceiling given in hours come out sixty times too short ("2h" gives 120 seconds instead of 7200).

=== TICKETS/TCK-5.md ===
# TCK-5: Workspace flush threshold: wrong key separator

In the scheduler service: Keys for the workspace flush threshold are joined with the wrong separator; they must be lower case words joined by '_' ("Foo Bar" → "foo_bar").

=== TICKETS/TCK-6.md ===
# TCK-6: Workspace drain timeout: alert misses the boundary

In the auth tokens service: The workspace drain timeout alert doesn't fire when the value is exactly 50; it should fire at 50 and above.

=== TICKETS/TCK-7.md ===
# TCK-7: Partner flush threshold: percentages truncated

In the webhooks service: Percentages for the partner flush threshold are truncated to whole numbers before rounding (1 of 3 should be 33.3).

=== TICKETS/TCK-8.md ===
# TCK-8: Device drain timeout: buckets twice too wide

In the auth tokens service: The device drain timeout groups values into buckets of 500; buckets are 250 wide.

=== TICKETS/TCK-9.md ===
# TCK-9: Pipeline batch size: IDs padded too short

In the scheduler service: IDs for the pipeline batch size are padded to 2 digits; the format is SKU-<n padded to 4 digits>.
